os-25-10.alt: One nephron with its blood vessels. On the left, a red artery and a blue vein run up and down side by side. A small arteriole leaves the artery and enters a tuft of capillaries cupped in a hollow capsule; a second arteriole leaves the tuft and branches into a mesh of capillaries that wraps around the coiled tubule and the long hairpin loop that dips downward. The capillary mesh drains through a venule into the vein. The tubule's last part joins a wide duct on the right that runs straight down, with an arrow showing urine flowing on toward the renal papilla.
